meta_description: Step-by-step guides for beginners: update Betaflight on an OpenFC flight controller and AM32 on an OpenESC, check it worked, and recover a failed update.
title: Firmware guides
lead: Step-by-step guides for updating the firmware on your OpenDrone boards, written for a first-timer. Every step says what you should see, and every page ends with what to do if it does not work.
flash_cta_note: The firmware page gives you the checked firmware file for your board, and installs it directly in Chrome or Edge.
safety_points: Flight controller over USB: keep the flight battery unplugged.
ESC: plug the battery in only at the step that asks for it, and unplug it when you are done.
Never unplug anything, close the tab or let the computer sleep while firmware is being written.
browser_points: Drag-and-drop update of the flight controller: any browser, on Windows, macOS or Linux.
Direct install, the Betaflight app and ESC flashing: Chrome or Edge on a computer.
A USB-C cable that carries data, not a charge-only cable.
